title: Arithmetic Models for Commodity Futures, Vanilla, and Calendar Spread Options
abstract: arXiv:2610.28071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop an arithmetic multi-factor stochastic volatility model for commodity futures and options. The arithmetic specification yields a low-dimensional Markovian representation of the futures curve and semi-closed-form pricing formulas for vanilla and basket options, including calendar spread options. These properties make the model suitable for large-scale empirical estimation.   We estimate the model using an unscented Kalman filter on a panel of WTI crude oil futures, vanilla options, and calendar spread options spanning 2013-2024. We find that three stochastic volatility factors are needed to capture both the level and slope of the volatility term structure, and that hedges based on these factors remove almost all of the daily risk of a portfolio of vanilla options. translated_title: 大宗商品期货、普通期权与日历价差期权的算术模型
translated_abstract: 我们为大宗商品期货和期权开发了一个算术型多因子随机波动率模型。该算术化设定使期货曲线具有低维马尔可夫表示，并为普通期权和篮子期权（包括日历价差期权）提供了半闭式定价公式。这些特性使该模型适合进行大规模实证估计。我们使用无迹卡尔曼滤波器，基于2013年至2024年间的WTI原油期货、普通期权和日历价差期权面板数据对模型进行了估计。我们发现，需要三个随机波动率因子才能同时捕捉波动率期限结构的水平和斜率，且基于这些因子的对冲策略几乎消除了普通期权组合的全部日内风险。日历价差期权提供了关于期货价格依赖结构的信息，而这些信息是仅凭期货和普通期权无法捕捉的。
tldr: 本文提出了一种算术型多因子随机波动率模型用于大宗商品期货与期权定价，通过WTI原油2013-2024年数据实证发现三个随机波动率因子即可刻画波动率期限结构，且日历价差期权蕴含着期货和普通期权无法捕捉的期货价格依赖结构信息。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an arithmetic multi-factor stochastic volatility model for commodity futures and options with low-dimensional Markovian representation and semi-closed-form pricing formulas, and using WTI crude oil data from 2013-2024 finds that three stochastic volatility factors suffice to capture the volatility term structure, while calendar spread options reveal dependence structure information not captured by futures and vanilla options alone.
